senses.definition: (√ of foll.; cf. Assyrian šêru, Pun. שאד, flesh, Arabic ثَأْرٌ blood revenge, so Sab. תֿאר, Sab.Denkm.No. 5, l.7; perhaps orig. blood (cf. Je 51:35), NöZMG xi (1886), 723 and Id.M 101, who cp. Mand. תירתא = ܬܻܐܪܳܬܐ conscience, mind, etc., perhaps proposes midriff, cf. Hoffminfr.).
